Optimize performance, reduce costs, and build scalable, future-ready storage solutions tailored for your unique needs.
Best-in-class HDD and SSD platforms delivering performance and scalability.
Open, flexible architectures that reduce costs and eliminate vendor lock-in.
Architecture guidance tailored to your unique infrastructure needs.
Optimize resource utilization with disaggregated storage. Minimize over-provisioning, scale storage independently from computer, and enable shared access across multiple servers.
Extend high performance from servers to storage across the network fabric, speeding up data access and enabling seamless sharing across multiple hosts. Ideal for demanding workloads.
Lower costs, extend hardware lifecycles, reduce energy usage, and maximize your investment with a more efficient infrastructure.
The Open Composable Compatibility Lab provides testing across dissagregated computer storage and networking so you can scale more efficiently, reduce costs, and deploy with greater confidence.
AI-ready platforms that deliver ultra-fast data access for inferencing and real-time analytics, massive capacity for training data lakes, and seamless connectivity across the fabric.
Removes traditional bottlenecks and delivers consistent, low-latency access to GPUs - ideal for high-throughput AI and HPC workloads
Accelerate application performance with a cost effective all flash high-availability solution built for performance and scalability.
Delivers high-density, energy-efficient storage with seamless scalability to unlock the full potential of SMR drives.
Capacity, performance and value that’s ready for what’s next.
Build for the intensive demands of AI, HPC, and cloud environments.
Enable disaggregation and share data at the speed of innovation.
Find the data center storage solutions for your needs
